agency: Department of Housing and Urban Development
summary: HUD explained that Environmental Statements are required for any Federally-assisted project and that BREAKTHROUGH sites are intended as demonstrations of careful planning.
text: Response: HUD requires appropriate Environmental Statements to be filed for any Federally-assisted project and provides evaluation and approval for such projects. The BREAKTHROUGH sites are intended as demonstrations of the value of careful planning.
opening_anchor: Response: HUD requires appropriate Environmental Statements to be filed for any Federally-assisted project and provides evaluation and approval for such projects.
closing_anchor: The BREAKTHROUGH sites are intended as demonstrations of the value of careful planning.
